description: Labelled pairs for calibrating LORE_MEMORY_RECALL_MIN_SIMILARITY (issue #199). Each pair is (stored memory, user query). 'related' pairs must stay above the recall floor, 'unrelated' pairs must fall below it. Written 2026-10-14; memory-style prose, English and German, deliberately including same-domain negatives (one label corrected 2026-10-14: sourdough hydration vs. water in bread dough is the same subject).

pairs.memory: Postgres connection pooling: use pgbouncer when a pool exceeds 50 connections; the default max_connections of 100 is not enough for our API pods.
pairs.query: how do I pool postgres connections
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Decision: the Godot test runner stays on the TrueNAS VM. Wake it over Wake-on-LAN, never shut it down.
pairs.query: wake on lan for the test host
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: The login form validates the email address client-side before submit, and the server repeats the check.
pairs.query: email validation on the login form
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: SSH into the homelab uses the forced-command key from the inventory; plain password auth is disabled everywhere.
pairs.query: how does ssh authentication work here
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Backup strategy: nightly restic to the NAS, 14 daily, 8 weekly, 4 monthly snapshots, repository encrypted.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Deployments wait for the review gate: push a review/* ref, run both reviewers, fast-forward only when nobody blocks.
pairs.query: when does a commit get merged to main
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Die Küche wird im November renoviert; der Elektriker braucht zwei Wochen Vorlauf für die Neuplanung der Steckdosen.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Client-side routing uses hash URLs so the app works from file:// without a server rewrite rule.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Python packaging: build with python -m build, publish with twine, and never upload secrets that ended up in the sdist.
pairs.query: how do I release a python package
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: The nightly job failed for three days because GNU timeout rejected the duration format 4h55m; use seconds instead.
pairs.query: why did the nightly job hang
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Flask sessions break on restart unless FLASK_SECRET_KEY is set; in production it comes from the environment.
pairs.query: flask session cookie lost after restart
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: SQLite writes run in WAL mode with a 5000 ms busy timeout so the web UI can read while a sync writes.
pairs.query: sqlite database is locked during sync
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Migration policy: never run a new migration against the live archive without a verified backup first.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Der Rasen wird erst gemäht, wenn drei Tage ohne Regen vergangen sind; Mähhöhe 4 cm im Frühjahr.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: TypeScript rule: use strict mode, unknown for parsed JSON, and type guards instead of any casts.
pairs.query: how should parsed json be typed
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: The extractor skips unchanged source files by mtime and parser version so a steady-state sync does not re-parse everything.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Rate limits for free models: 20 requests per minute and 50 per day below ten purchased credits.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: The web UI is served behind Traefik with a forwarded-for header that is only trusted when the proxy flag is set.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Docker images are pinned to a digest, run as a non-root user, and declare a healthcheck for production.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Memory recall is fused with keyword hits by reciprocal rank fusion; memories without a vector still surface through keywords.
pairs.query: how are keyword and semantic results combined
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits and always name the issue number in the subject or body.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: The garden irrigation runs at 06:00 for 20 minutes; in August it switches to every second day.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: CSP: script tags carry a per-response nonce, inline handlers are forbidden, and external origins are allow-listed.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Pruning keeps 200 sessions in the index; older ones are archived to cold storage and drop out of search.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: The bug was an off-by-one in the pagination cursor: the last row of a page was requested twice.
pairs.query: why does the last row appear twice
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Pre-commit hooks run ruff format, ruff check and the unit tests; never skip them with --no-verify.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: Für das Homeoffice brauche ich einen Monitor mit USB-C Power Delivery und mindestens 90 Watt.
pairs.label: related

pairs.memory: The queue worker exits with code 1 when any job failed, so systemd marks the unit as failed.
pairs.label: related
